title: Mixing colours
examples: Teacher, what are the main colours?
If I mix blue and yellow, what colour do I get?
Can we make green paint today?

explain.say: Today we are learning about colours. We will see how colours can mix.
The three primary colours are red, yellow, and blue. You cannot make these colours by mixing other colours.
If we mix red paint and yellow paint together, a new colour appears. This new colour is orange.
Let us try mixing some colours now. You can mix red and yellow to see orange.
Look at a sunset in the sky. The colours mixing there show us this idea. Red and yellow mix to make orange.
A common mistake is thinking all colours are primary. Remember, red, yellow, and blue are the special primary colours.

faq.q: What are the main colours we start with?
faq.a: The three primary colours are red, yellow, and blue. You can mix these to make other colours.

faq.q: What colour do I get if I mix red and yellow?
faq.a: When you mix red and yellow paint together, you get the colour orange. It is a new colour.
asks: Can mixing red and yellow make gold?

faq.q: Are there more than three primary colours?
faq.a: No, there are only three primary colours: red, yellow, and blue. These are the starting colours.
asks: Do we need more than three colours?
What colours are the most basic?

faq.q: What is the difference between primary and secondary colours?
faq.a: Primary colours are the basic ones like red and yellow. Secondary colours are made by mixing two primary colours.
asks: If I mix two colours, what is it called?

faq.q: If I mix blue and yellow, what colour will I get?
faq.a: You will get green. Green is a secondary colour made from blue and yellow.

facts: The three primary colours are red, yellow, and blue.
Mixing red and yellow creates the secondary colour orange.
Primary colours cannot be made by mixing other colours.

quiz.say: Which set of colours are all primary colours?
quiz.why: These three colours are the basic colours that cannot be made by mixing others.

wrong.0: Green is made from mixing blue and yellow, so it is not primary.
wrong.1: Purple is made from mixing red and blue, so it is not primary.
wrong.3: Orange is a secondary colour, so this set is incorrect.

quiz.say: If you mix red and yellow paint, what colour do you get?
quiz.why: Mixing red and yellow always creates the secondary colour orange.

wrong.0: Brown is a darker colour, but mixing red and yellow makes orange.
wrong.1: Green is made by mixing blue and yellow, not red and yellow.
wrong.2: Black is made by mixing all colours together, not just red and yellow.

quiz.say: Which of these colours is NOT a primary colour?
quiz.why: Orange is a secondary colour made from red and yellow.

wrong.0: Red is one of the three basic primary colours.
wrong.1: Blue is one of the three basic primary colours.
wrong.2: Yellow is one of the three basic primary colours.
